title: Three-loop renormalization of the N=1, N=2, N=4 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories
journal: Nucl. Phys. B (2009), DOI 10.1016/j.nuclphysb.2009.03.017 (volume/page not verified); erratum referenced in v5
claim: Three-loop renormalization constants of N=1, 2, 4 SYM in DRED in an arbitrary covariant gauge, from the 1PI fermion-fermion-vector, scalar-scalar-vector, ghost-ghost-vector and fermion-fermion-scalar vertices and all propagators. N=1 and N=4: beta functions from different vertices coincide. Original versions had an N=2 Yukawa mismatch; v3-v5 (2026) trace it to using tr[alpha^r beta^t] = 0 (eq. 10), valid only for N=4, and correct it (eqs. 11-12, c=-1/4). Conclusion of v5: gauge and Yukawa couplings renormalize identically for N=1, 2, 4 (and N=1 in D=4, 6, 10), so DRED preserves SUSY up to three loops. States that Avdeev's (1982) three-loop SUSY-breaking result is incorrect for N=1 in D=4 (first noted by Harlander et al., JHEP 2006).
theory: N=1, N=2, N=4 SYM (also via D=6, 10 SYM reductions)
scheme: DRED via reduction of 10D N=1 SYM (6+2eps scalars in 4D), MS-like, infrared rearrangement, MINCER/FORM, DIANA/QGRAF, COLOR; gamma-algebra and Levi-Civita treatment not described.
symmetry_argument: Explicit equality of beta functions extracted from different vertices (gauge vs Yukawa).

checked_partially: Three-loop equality of gauge and Yukawa coupling renormalization in N=1, N=4 (since 2008) and N=2 (after the 2026 correction).

evidence: eq. (8) gauge-vertex beta; eq. (9) original Yukawa beta; eq. (10) trace relation; eqs. (11)-(12) corrected Yukawa beta.
Appendix eqs. (13)-(24): Z's for N=4, N=2, N=1.
red_flags: The N=2 conclusion changed 18 years after v1; the fix hinges on a flavour-trace (Levi-Civita-type) structure, i.e. the same gamma5/epsilon-tensor sensitivity that makes DRED delicate.
Quartic scalar coupling renormalization (the third SUSY relation in N=2, N=4) not reported in the summary seen.
Equality of beta functions is a necessary condition only; not a Slavnov-Taylor identity check.
cross_checks: Velizhanin four-loop Konishi 0808.3832 and four-loop N=4 beta 1008.2198 (section 1a, other worker)
notes: Lead check: the four-loop N=4 beta paper is arXiv:1008.2198 (as cited in 2603.02892), not 1008.2911.
